"""One fixed frozen-encoder comparison: strict native versus source-aware addition.

Both heads share native-fit standardization and alpha10, with identical zero
initial coefficients. Added PIGS/Li rows change the training population. Each
canonical star contributes once; evaluation retains separate raw source layers.
"""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import resource
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

import h5py
import numpy as np
import run_xp_representation_probes as probe
import torch
import yaml
from run_native_age import SCALER_SHA, state_digest
from run_pristine_value import replay
from run_stellar_label_experiments import BENCH, PARENT, PARENT_SHA
from stellar_age_cohorts import file_digest
from stellar_catalog_jobs import atomic_json, identity_split
from stellar_dataset_views import EXPECTED_IDS

from masked_stellar_autoencoder.models.checkpoint_load import torch_load_trusted

ROOT = Path("/arc/projects/k-pop/msa_runs/stellar-improvement-20261015")
COHORT_SHA = "321f27234bc306f64ef1a942fef981663f3c50df84990359b9943a1979262120"
CONTENT = "947e79c4aa27913b9b2693095ed806c9494c0fad85bcfd6b203a2e9edde53e94"
LAYERS = ("native", "PIGS", "Li2025_CaT_silver")
BLOCKED = ["RA", "DEC", "pmra", "pmdec", "PARALLAX", "distance", "age", "e_age"]


def prepare(path):
    """Resolve canonical fits and source-separated test layers without leakage."""
    with h5py.File(path) as f:
        c = {n: f["canonical/" + n][:] for n in f["canonical"]}
        ids = f["features/source_id"][:]
        partition = f["features/benchmark_partition"][:]
        split = identity_split(ids)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(f["features/label_split"][:], split)
        feature_rows = c["feature_row"]
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(ids[feature_rows], c["source_id"])
        strict = (split[feature_rows] == 0) & (partition[feature_rows] == 0)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(c["strict_fit"], strict)
        measurements = {n: f["raw_layers/" + n + "/measurements"][:] for n in LAYERS}
        canonical_y = np.empty(len(feature_rows), dtype="f8")
        expected_layer = np.full(len(ids), -1, dtype="i1")
        available = f["features/feature_available"][:]
        tests = {}
        for code, n in enumerate(LAYERS):
            m = measurements[n]
            rows = f["layer_index/" + n + "/feature_row"][:]
            np.testing.assert_array_equal(ids[rows], m["source_id"])
            first = available[rows] & (expected_layer[rows] < 0)
            expected_layer[rows[first]] = code
            test = available[rows] & (split[rows] == 2)
            np.testing.assert_array_equal(
                f["layer_index/" + n + "/identity_test"][:], test
            )
            tests[n] = dict(feature_row=rows[test], measurements=m[test])
            take = c["layer"] == code
            chosen = m[c["layer_row"][take]]
            np.testing.assert_array_equal(chosen["source_id"], c["source_id"][take])
            canonical_y[take] = chosen["value"]
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(c["layer"], expected_layer[feature_rows])
        fits = np.flatnonzero(strict)
        used = np.unique(
            np.r_[feature_rows[fits], *[v["feature_row"] for v in tests.values()]]
        )
        augmented = np.searchsorted(used, feature_rows[fits])
        native = augmented[c["layer"][fits] == 0]
        y = np.full(len(used), np.nan, dtype="f8")
        y[augmented] = canonical_y[fits]
        for n, t in tests.items():
            t["used_row"] = np.searchsorted(used, t["feature_row"])
            assert not np.isin(
                t["measurements"]["source_id"], ids[used[augmented]]
            ).any()
        assert (partition[used[augmented]] == 0).all()
        assert (split[used[augmented]] == 0).all()
        assert np.isfinite(y[augmented]).all()
        return dict(
            source_id=ids[used],
            feature_row=used,
            raw_values=f["features/values"][:][used],
            native_fit=native,
            augmented_fit=augmented,
            fit_truth=y,
            tests=tests,
            feature_columns=json.loads(f.attrs["feature_columns_json"]),
            fit_source_layer=c["layer"][fits],
            center=f["reference_scaler/center"][:],
            scale=f["reference_scaler/scale"][:],
        )


def fit_heads(latent, y, native, augmented):
    """Common native-fit-only scaling, fixed alpha; no evaluation labels enter."""
    latent = np.asarray(latent, dtype="f8")
    native, augmented = np.asarray(native), np.asarray(augmented)
    if not np.isfinite(latent).all() or not np.isfinite(y[augmented]).all():
        raise ValueError("Nonfinite fit inputs")
    if (
        len(native) < 20
        or len(np.unique(augmented)) != len(augmented)
        or not np.isin(native, augmented).all()
    ):
        raise ValueError("Invalid nested fit cohorts")
    center, scale = latent[native].mean(0), latent[native].std(0)
    scale = np.where(scale > 1e-8, scale, 1.0)
    yc, ys = float(y[native].mean()), max(float(y[native].std()), 1e-8)
    design = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(latent)), (latent - center) / scale])
    penalty = np.eye(design.shape[1]) * 10.0
    penalty[0, 0] = 0
    states = {}
    for name, rows in [("native_only", native), ("canonical_augmented", augmented)]:
        a = design[rows]
        coef = np.linalg.solve(a.T @ a + penalty, a.T @ ((y[rows] - yc) / ys))
        states[name] = dict(
            center=center.copy(), scale=scale.copy(), coef=coef, ycenter=yc, yscale=ys
        )
    return states


def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    p.add_argument("--run-id", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    args = p.parse_args()
    args.output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    manifest = dict(
        status="running",
        run_id=args.run_id,
        policy="Frozen epoch57, fixed alpha10 ridge; same native-fit-only scaling and zero initial heads. Native19859 versus canonical20267fits with219PIGS+189Li additions. No SGD. Source-separated tests; added rows change population objective, not matched presentation budgets.",
        caveat="Native FeH/PIGS/Li CaT silver retain distinct calibration and uncertainty tiers; no shifts/averaging/calibrated NLL or unseen-pretraining/SOTA claim.",
    )
    atomic_json(args.output / "manifest.json", manifest)
    started = time.monotonic()
    try:
        cohort = ROOT / "enriched_feature_cohort_v1/enriched-feature-cohort.h5"
        gate = json.loads(
            (ROOT / "enriched_feature_audit_v1/manifest.json").read_text()
        )
        if (
            gate.get("status") != "complete"
            or not gate["result"].get("publication_gate_complete")
            or gate["result"]["cohort_sha256"] != COHORT_SHA
            or gate["result"]["content_id"] != CONTENT
        ):
            raise ValueError("Independent original-source publication gate incomplete")
        if file_digest(cohort) != COHORT_SHA or file_digest(PARENT) != PARENT_SHA:
            raise ValueError("Immutable cohort/parent changed")
        data = prepare(cohort)
        if len(data["native_fit"]) != 19859 or len(data["augmented_fit"]) != 20267:
            raise ValueError("Declared actual fit counts changed")
        features = data["feature_columns"]
        config = yaml.safe_load(Path("configs/pretrain.canfar.yaml").read_text())
        if features != config["data"]["feature_cols"]:
            raise ValueError("Feature order changed")
        with h5py.File(cohort) as f:
            # Original source audit is complete; still recheck real 128 matched XP units.
            units = probe.audit_fits_xp_units(
                BENCH,
                features,
                f["features/values"][:],
                f["features/source_id"][:],
                "g_normalized",
            )
        checkpoint = torch_load_trusted(PARENT, map_location="cpu", weights_only=False)
        sig = checkpoint["run_signature"]
        center = np.asarray(sig["scaler_center"])
        scale = np.asarray(sig["scaler_scale"])
        if hashlib.sha256(center.tobytes() + scale.tobytes()).hexdigest() != SCALER_SHA:
            raise ValueError("Parent scaler changed")
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(center, data["center"])
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(scale, data["scale"])
        safe = probe.safe_inputs(
            (data["raw_values"] - center) / scale, features, ["fe_h"], BLOCKED
        )
        device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
        torch.manual_seed(42)
        model = probe.load_model(config, checkpoint, device)
        for parameter in model.parameters():
            parameter.requires_grad_(False)
        initial_encoder = state_digest(model.encoder)
        latent = probe.encode(model, safe, device)
        states = fit_heads(
            latent, data["fit_truth"], data["native_fit"], data["augmented_fit"]
        )
        paired = {
            k: data[k]
            for k in [
                "source_id",
                "feature_row",
                "raw_values",
                "fit_truth",
                "native_fit",
                "augmented_fit",
                "fit_source_layer",
            ]
        }
        paired.update(safe_inputs=safe, latent=latent)
        for n, t in data["tests"].items():
            paired[n + "__measurements"] = t["measurements"]
            paired[n + "__used_row"] = t["used_row"]
        np.savez_compressed(args.output / "paired-cohort.npz", **paired)
        predictions = {}
        initial = {}
        results = {}
        for name, state in states.items():
            np.savez(args.output / (name + "-head.npz"), **state)
            prediction = replay(latent, state)
            with np.load(args.output / (name + "-head.npz")) as saved:
                np.testing.assert_array_equal(prediction, replay(latent, saved))
            predictions[name] = prediction
            initial[name] = np.full(len(latent), state["ycenter"])
            initial[name + "__coef"] = np.zeros_like(state["coef"])
            results[name] = {}
            for n, t in data["tests"].items():
                target = t["measurements"]["value"]
                pred = prediction[t["used_row"]]
                bins = {
                    "all": np.ones(len(target), bool),
                    "below_minus3": target < -3,
                    "minus3_to_minus2": (target >= -3) & (target < -2),
                    "minus2_to_minus1": (target >= -2) & (target < -1),
                    "at_least_minus1": target >= -1,
                }
                results[name][n] = {
                    key: probe.score(pred[mask], target[mask])
                    for key, mask in bins.items()
                }
                if "survey" in t["measurements"].dtype.names:
                    surveys = t["measurements"]["survey"]
                    results[name][n]["per_survey"] = {
                        str(survey): probe.score(
                            pred[surveys == survey], target[surveys == survey]
                        )
                        for survey in np.unique(surveys)
                    }
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(
            initial["native_only"], initial["canonical_augmented"]
        )
        np.savez_compressed(
            args.output / "initial_predictions.npz",
            source_id=data["source_id"],
            **initial,
        )
        np.savez_compressed(
            args.output / "predictions.npz", source_id=data["source_id"], **predictions
        )
        torch.save(
            dict(encoder=model.encoder.state_dict()), args.output / "encoder.pth"
        )
        restored = probe.load_model(config, checkpoint, device)
        restored.encoder.load_state_dict(
            torch_load_trusted(
                args.output / "encoder.pth", map_location=device, weights_only=False
            )["encoder"],
            strict=True,
        )
        replay_latent = probe.encode(restored, safe, device)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(replay_latent, latent)
        for name, state in states.items():
            np.testing.assert_array_equal(
                replay(replay_latent, state), predictions[name]
            )
        assert (
            state_digest(model.encoder) == initial_encoder
            and file_digest(PARENT) == PARENT_SHA
        )
        atomic_json(
            args.output / "checkpoint_verification.json",
            dict(
                full_encoder_reload_all_rows_exact=True,
                both_heads_reload_all_rows_exact=True,
                encoder_unchanged=True,
                parent_unchanged=True,
                optimizer_steps=0,
            ),
        )
        atomic_json(args.output / "comparison.json", results)
        manifest.update(
            benchmark_ordered_source_id_sha256=EXPECTED_IDS,
            peak_cpu_rss_bytes=int(resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss)
            * (1 if sys.platform == "darwin" else 1024),
            peak_cuda_allocated_bytes=torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated()
            if device.type == "cuda"
            else 0,
            peak_cuda_reserved_bytes=torch.cuda.max_memory_reserved()
            if device.type == "cuda"
            else 0,
            status="complete",
            results=results,
            unit_audit=units,
            source_gate=gate["result"],
            cohort_sha256=COHORT_SHA,
            cohort_content_id=CONTENT,
            parent_sha256=PARENT_SHA,
            scaler_sha256=SCALER_SHA,
            encoder_state_sha256=initial_encoder,
            encoded_rows=len(safe),
            native_fit_count=len(data["native_fit"]),
            augmented_fit_count=len(data["augmented_fit"]),
            runtime_seconds=time.monotonic() - started,
            device=str(device),
            blocked_features=BLOCKED,
            feature_columns=features,
            alpha=10.0,
            training_updates=0,
        )
    except Exception as error:
        manifest.update(status="failed", error=repr(error))
        atomic_json(args.output / "manifest.json", manifest)
        raise
    atomic_json(args.output / "manifest.json", manifest)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import argparse

import h5py

def digest(path):
    with open(path, "rb") as handle:
        return hashlib.file_digest(handle, "sha256").hexdigest()


def replica_directory(root, replica, index, count):
    """Every SIMEX model is independently reproducible; ordinary arms stay flat."""
    if count == 1:
        return root
    path = (
        root
        / f"replica-{index:03d}-lambda-{replica['lambda_value']:g}-sim-{replica['simulation']}"
    )
    path.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    for name in (
        "initial_reconstruction.npz",
        "dropout_policy.json",
        "optimizer_policy.json",
    ):
        source = root / name
        if source.exists():
            shutil.copy2(source, path / name)
    return path


def replay_batches(cache, budget, batch_size):
    """Sequential train-only passes, with an exact truncated final batch."""
    if min(len(cache), budget, batch_size) < 1:
        raise ValueError("Replay lengths and budget must be positive")
    seen = 0
    while seen < budget:
        for start in range(0, len(cache), batch_size):
            stop = min(start + batch_size, len(cache), start + budget - seen)
            if stop <= start:
                return
            yield np.arange(start, stop), np.array(cache[start:stop])
            seen += stop - start
            if seen == budget:
                return


def native_inputs(cohort, limit=None):
    data = prepare(cohort)
    fit = data["native_fit"]
    # The fit cohorts and global source-ID roles are audited again by prepare().
    test = data["tests"]["native"]
    if limit is None and (len(fit) != 19859 or len(test["used_row"]) != 100620):
        raise ValueError("Declared native cohort counts changed")
    if limit is not None:
        fit = fit[:limit]
        test = {
            "used_row": test["used_row"][:limit],
            "measurements": test["measurements"][:limit],
        }
    target = data["fit_truth"][fit]
    yc, ys = float(target.mean()), float(target.std())
    if not np.isfinite(ys) or ys <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Native fit target scale must be positive")
    values = (data["raw_values"] - data["center"]) / data["scale"]
    safe, visible = spectrophotometric_inputs(
        torch.from_numpy(values.astype("f4")),
        torch.from_numpy(np.isfinite(data["raw_values"])),
        data["feature_columns"],
    )
    x = safe.numpy()
    assert not np.isin(data["source_id"][fit], test["measurements"]["source_id"]).any()
    assert (identity_split(data["source_id"][fit]) == 0).all()
    with h5py.File(cohort) as source:
        raw_native = source["raw_layers/native/measurements"][:]
    order = np.argsort(raw_native["source_id"])
    matched = raw_native[
        order[np.searchsorted(raw_native["source_id"][order], data["source_id"][fit])]
    ]
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(matched["source_id"], data["source_id"][fit])
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(matched["value"], data["fit_truth"][fit])
    data["fit_native_measurements"] = matched
    return data, fit, test, x, visible.numpy(), yc, ys


@torch.no_grad()
def predict(model, head, values, device, batch_size=512):
    model.eval()
    head.eval()
    if isinstance(head, ConditionalFlowHead):
        batch_size = min(batch_size, 128)
    return np.concatenate(
        [
            head(model.encoder(torch.as_tensor(block, device=device))).cpu().numpy()
            for block in np.array_split(
                values, max(1, int(np.ceil(len(values) / batch_size)))
            )
        ]
    )


@torch.no_grad()
def reconstruct(model, values, mask, device, micro=512):
    model.eval()
    predictions = []
    for start in range(0, len(values), micro):
        raw = torch.as_tensor(np.array(values[start : start + micro]), device=device)
        hidden = raw.masked_fill(
            torch.as_tensor(mask[start : start + micro], device=device)
            | ~torch.isfinite(raw),
            -9999,
        )
        predictions.append(model(hidden)[0].cpu().numpy())
    return np.concatenate(predictions)


def probabilistic_metrics(outputs, truth, center, scale, label_sigma_dex=None):
    """Observed-label Gaussian diagnostics, never inferred for Huber heads."""
    out = torch.from_numpy(outputs).double()
    y = torch.from_numpy(np.asarray((truth - center) / scale, dtype="f8"))
    mean = out[:, 0, 0].numpy() * scale + center
    sigma = (out[:, 0, 1] * 0.5).exp().numpy() * scale
    metrics = dict(
        gaussian_crps_dex=float(prediction_loss(out, y, "gaussian_crps")) * scale,
        gaussian_nll_dex=float(prediction_loss(out, y, "gaussian_nll"))
        + float(np.log(scale)),
        central_68_27_coverage=float(np.mean(np.abs(truth - mean) <= sigma)),
        central_95_coverage=float(
            np.mean(np.abs(truth - mean) <= 1.959963984540054 * sigma)
        ),
        mean_sigma_dex=float(sigma.mean()),
        target="reported_native_FeH_not_error_deconvolved_truth",
        quoted_label_error_included=False,
    )
    if label_sigma_dex is None:
        return metrics
    quoted = np.asarray(label_sigma_dex, dtype="f8")
    if (
        quoted.shape != truth.shape
        or not np.isfinite(quoted).all()
        or np.any(quoted <= 0)
    ):
        raise ValueError("Test quoted FeH errors must be finite and positive")
    total = np.sqrt(sigma**2 + quoted**2)
    standardized = torch.as_tensor((quoted / scale) ** 2, dtype=torch.float64)
    metrics.update(
        quoted_label_error_included=True,
        quoted_error_is_not_total_calibrated_sigma=True,
        convolved_gaussian_nll_dex=float(
            prediction_loss(
                out, y, "gaussian_nll_label_error", label_variance=standardized
            )
        )
        + float(np.log(scale)),
        convolved_central_68_27_coverage=float(np.mean(np.abs(truth - mean) <= total)),
        convolved_central_95_coverage=float(
            np.mean(np.abs(truth - mean) <= 1.959963984540054 * total)
        ),
        mean_convolved_sigma_dex=float(total.mean()),
    )
    return metrics


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--run-id", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--config", default="configs/prediction-comparison-10m.yaml")
    parser.add_argument("--checkpoint", default=os.getenv("MSA_PRETRAIN_RESUME"))
    parser.add_argument("--benchmark", default=BENCH)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--cohort",
        default="/arc/projects/k-pop/msa_runs/stellar-improvement-20261015/enriched_feature_cohort_v1/enriched-feature-cohort.h5",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--smoke",
        action="store_true",
        help="Explicit local numerical integration, never a production result",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args()
    os.environ.setdefault(
        "MPLCONFIGDIR",
        "/tmp/msa-prediction-matplotlib"
        if args.smoke
        else str(args.output / ".mplcache"),
    )
    suite = yaml.safe_load(Path(args.config).read_text())
    arm = next(a for a in suite["arms"] if a["run_id"] == args.run_id)
    suite = resolve_policy(suite, arm)
    seed = experiment_seed(suite, arm)
    seed_offset = dropout_offset(int(arm.get("experiment_seed", 42)))
    args.output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    manifest = dict(
        status="running",
        run_id=args.run_id,
        smoke=args.smoke,
        policy=suite,
        arm=arm,
        source_sha=subprocess.check_output(
            ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True
        ).strip(),
        caveat="Native reported-label prediction; Gaussian scores describe observed labels, not deconvolved/calibrated stellar truth. Pretraining overlap not excluded. BatchEnsemble head is TabM-style, not official TabM.",
    )
    atomic_json(args.output / "manifest.json", manifest)
    started = time.monotonic()
    try:
        if arm.get("library_revision"):
            direct = json.loads(
                importlib.metadata.distribution("torchregress").read_text(
                    "direct_url.json"
                )
            )
            if direct.get("vcs_info", {}).get("commit_id") != arm["library_revision"]:
                raise ValueError(
                    "Installed torchregress differs from the arm's immutable library pin"
                )
            manifest["torchregress_provenance"] = direct
        checkpoint_sha = digest(args.checkpoint)
        if not args.smoke and checkpoint_sha != suite["checkpoint_sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("Pinned parent digest differs")
        if digest(args.cohort) != COHORT_SHA:

"""CPU catalogue inventory, source-aware label registry and experiment split plans.

All output is new/versioned; input catalogues and benchmark are read-only.
"""

import argparse
import datetime as dt
import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

import h5py
import numpy as np
import yaml
from astropy.io import fits


def atomic_json(path, value):
    tmp = path.with_suffix(".building")
    tmp.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    tmp.replace(path)


def verify_expected_fits_rows(hdul, expected_rows):
    """Reject truncated TAP exports before publishing them as full catalogues."""
    if expected_rows is None:
        return
    tables = [h for h in hdul if isinstance(h, fits.BinTableHDU)]
    if len(tables) != 1 or len(tables[0].data) != int(expected_rows):
        raise ValueError("FITS catalogue row count differs from expected full release")


def identity_split(ids):
    x = np.asarray(ids, dtype=np.uint64) ^ np.uint64(42)
    with np.errstate(over="ignore"):
        x = (x ^ (x >> np.uint64(30))) * np.uint64(0xBF58476D1CE4E5B9)
        x = (x ^ (x >> np.uint64(27))) * np.uint64(0x94D049BB133111EB)
        x ^= x >> np.uint64(31)
    return np.where(x % 1000 < 700, 0, np.where(x % 1000 < 850, 1, 2)).astype("u1")


def inventory(root):
    found = []
    for base, dirs, files in os.walk(root):
        depth = len(Path(base).relative_to(root).parts)
        dirs[:] = sorted(dirs) if depth < 3 else []
        for name in sorted(files):
            if any(
                s in name.lower()
                for s in [
                    "galah",
                    "apogee",
                    "allstar",
                    "astronn",
                    "li_et",
                    "pigs",
                    "pristine",
                    "mwsall",
                    "ftset_spec",
                ]
            ):
                p = Path(base) / name
                row = {"path": str(p), "bytes": p.stat().st_size}
                if name.endswith((".fits", ".fits.gz", ".fit")):
                    try:
                        with fits.open(p, memmap=True, lazy_load_hdus=True) as f:
                            table = next(
                                x for x in f if isinstance(x, fits.BinTableHDU)
                            )
                            row.update(
                                rows=table.header["NAXIS2"],
                                columns=table.columns.names,
                                units={c.name: c.unit for c in table.columns if c.unit},
                            )
                    except Exception as error:
                        row["schema_error"] = str(error)
                found.append(row)
    return found


def selected_native(table, source):
    names = {n.lower(): n for n in table.names}

    def col(aliases, default=np.nan):
        n = next((names[a.lower()] for a in aliases if a.lower() in names), None)
        return np.asarray(table[n]) if n else np.full(len(table), default)

    ids = col(["source_id", "gaiadr3_source_id", "gaiaedr3_source_id"], 0).astype("i8")
    value = col(["fe_h", "feh", "fe_h_corr"]).astype("f8")
    error = col(["e_fe_h", "fe_h_err", "e_feh"]).astype("f8")
    eligible = (
        (ids > 0)
        & np.isfinite(value)
        & np.isfinite(error)
        & (error > 0)
        & (error < 0.5)
    )
    if source == "galah":
        if not {"flag_sp", "flag_fe_h"} <= names.keys():
            eligible[:] = False
        else:
            eligible &= (col(["flag_sp"]) == 0) & (col(["flag_fe_h"]) == 0)
    elif source == "apogee":
        # Native FE_H only, never M_H. Require flags; preserve rejected records too.
        if not {"aspcapflag", "starflag", "fe_h_flag"} <= names.keys():
            eligible[:] = False
        else:
            eligible &= (
                (col(["aspcapflag"]) == 0)
                & (col(["starflag"]) == 0)
                & (col(["fe_h_flag"]) == 0)
            )
    return ids, value, error, eligible


def build_registry(args, inv, scratch):
    # Retain every source measurement; do not pick the first catalogue row.
    dtype = np.dtype(
        [
            ("source_id", "<i8"),
            ("value", "<f8"),
            ("uncertainty", "<f8"),
            ("quantity", "S8"),
            ("survey", "S32"),
            ("input_file", "S512"),
            ("source_row", "<i8"),
            ("quality_pass", "?"),
            ("split", "u1"),
        ]
    )
    staged = scratch / "labels.h5.building"
    totals = {}
    native = []
    legacy = Path(args.legacy)
    with h5py.File(staged, "x") as out:
        ds = out.create_dataset(
            "measurements",
            shape=(0,),
            maxshape=(None,),
            dtype=dtype,
            chunks=(16384,),
            compression="gzip",
            compression_opts=1,
        )
        files = [(legacy, "legacy")]
        for item in inv:
            path = Path(item["path"])
            low = path.name.lower()
            if path == legacy or not low.endswith(".fits"):
                continue
            survey = (
                "galah"
                if "galah_dr4" in low
                else "apogee"
                if "sdss-apogee" in low or low.startswith("allstar")
                else None
            )
            if survey:
                files.append((path, survey))
        for index, (path, survey) in enumerate(files):
            local = scratch / f"input-{index}.fits"
            shutil.copyfile(path, local)
            with fits.open(local, memmap=True) as f:
                table = next(x for x in f if isinstance(x, fits.BinTableHDU)).data
                for start in range(0, len(table), 65536):
                    block = table[start : start + 65536]
                    if survey == "legacy":
                        ids = np.asarray(block["source_id"], dtype="i8")
                        value = np.asarray(block["fe_h"], dtype="f8")
                        error = np.asarray(block["e_fe_h"], dtype="f8")
                        tags = np.char.strip(
                            np.asarray(block["spec_source"]).astype(str)
                        )
                        quantity = np.where(tags == "apogee-latentage", "MH", "FeH")
                        eligible = (
                            (tags == "li_et_al_vmps")
                            & (ids > 0)
                            & np.isfinite(value)
                            & np.isfinite(error)
                            & (error > 0)
                            & (error < 0.5)
                        )
                        # Legacy GALAH quality flags were discarded; never claim quality controlled.
                    else:
                        ids, value, error, eligible = selected_native(block, survey)
                        tags = np.full(len(block), survey)
                        quantity = np.full(len(block), "FeH")
                    records = np.zeros(len(block), dtype=dtype)
                    for key, v in [
                        ("source_id", ids),
                        ("value", value),
                        ("uncertainty", error),
                        ("quantity", quantity.astype("S8")),
                        ("survey", tags.astype("S32")),
                        ("input_file", str(path).encode()),
                        ("source_row", np.arange(start, start + len(block))),
                        ("quality_pass", eligible),
                        ("split", identity_split(ids)),
                    ]:
                        records[key] = v
                    n = len(ds)
                    ds.resize(n + len(records), axis=0)
                    ds[n:] = records
                    for tag in np.unique(tags):
                        select = tags == tag
                        t = totals.setdefault(
                            str(tag), {"measurements": 0, "quality_pass": 0}
                        )
                        t["measurements"] += int(select.sum())
                        t["quality_pass"] += int((select & eligible).sum())
                native.append({"path": str(path), "source": survey, "rows": len(table)})
            local.unlink()
        out.attrs["chemical_definition"] = (
            "FeH and MH retained separately; survey systematics not silently corrected"
        )
        out.attrs["age_policy"] = (
            "Legacy synthetic sqrt(age) errors are excluded; age target assembly pending native quality audit"
        )
        out.attrs["distance_policy"] = (
            "No inverse-parallax distance labels; probabilistic distance targets require independent quality metadata"
        )
        # Unique selected FeH stars, priority high-resolution Li then flagged native surveys.
        candidates = ds[:]
        ok = candidates["quality_pass"] & (candidates["quantity"] == b"FeH")
        good = candidates[ok]
        rank = np.where(
            good["survey"] == b"li_et_al_vmps",
            0,
            np.where(good["survey"] == b"galah", 1, 2),
        )
        order = np.lexsort((good["uncertainty"], rank, good["source_id"]))
        good = good[order]
        keep = (
            np.r_[True, good["source_id"][1:] != good["source_id"][:-1]]
            if len(good)
            else np.array([], dtype=bool)
        )
        out.create_dataset("selected/labels", data=good[keep], compression="gzip")
        out.attrs["selected_rows"] = int(keep.sum())
    destination = args.output / "labels.h5"
    copying = args.output / "labels.h5.copying"
    if destination.exists() or copying.exists():
        raise FileExistsError(destination)
    shutil.copyfile(staged, copying)
    with h5py.File(copying, "r") as f:
        assert len(f["measurements"]) == sum(v["measurements"] for v in totals.values())
        selected = len(f["selected/labels"])
        assert len(np.unique(f["selected/labels"]["source_id"])) == selected
    copying.replace(destination)
    return {
        "label_file": str(destination),
        "bytes": destination.stat().st_size,
        "sources": totals,
        "inputs": native,
        "selected_FeH_stars": selected,
        "native_galah_apogee_complete": all(
            any(x["source"] == s for x in native) for s in ["galah", "apogee"]
        ),
        "age_distance_status": "native labels and independent validation pending; no fabricated targets",
    }


def collect(args):
    spec = yaml.safe_load(Path(args.sources).read_text())
    results = []
    selected = set(filter(None, os.environ.get("MSA_CATALOG_SOURCES", "").split(",")))
    known = {item["name"] for item in spec["sources"]}
    if selected - known:
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown catalogue sources: {sorted(selected - known)}")
    for item in spec["sources"]:
        if selected and item["name"] not in selected:
            continue
        result = dict(item)
        try:
            limit = int(item.get("max_bytes", args.max_bytes))
            request = urllib.request.Request(
                item["url"],
                method="HEAD",
                headers={"User-Agent": "MSA-science-catalogue-audit/1.0"},
            )
            try:
                with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=40) as response:
                    result.update(
                        http_status=response.status,
                        content_length=response.headers.get("Content-Length"),
                        content_type=response.headers.get("Content-Type"),
                    )
            except Exception as error:
                result["head_error"] = str(error)
            if item.get("download") and int(result.get("content_length") or 0) <= limit:
                published = args.output / item["filename"]
                target = (
                    Path(
                        os.environ.get(
                            "MSA_LABEL_SCRATCH", "/scratch/msa-label-staging"
                        )
                    )
                    / args.run_id
                    / item["filename"]
                )
                partial = target.with_suffix(target.suffix + ".copying")
                if published.exists():
                    raise FileExistsError(published)
                if target.exists() or partial.exists():
                    raise FileExistsError(target)
                with (
                    urllib.request.urlopen(item["url"], timeout=180) as source,
                    partial.open("xb") as dest,
                ):
                    digest = hashlib.sha256()
                    size = 0
                    while chunk := source.read(1024 * 1024):
                        size += len(chunk)
                        if size > limit:
                            raise ValueError(
                                "Download exceeds bounded per-product limit"
                            )
                        digest.update(chunk)
                        dest.write(chunk)
                if (
                    item.get("expected_sha256")
                    and digest.hexdigest() != item["expected_sha256"]
                ):
                    raise ValueError("Catalogue checksum mismatch")
                partial.replace(target)
                result.update(
                    file=str(published), sha256=digest.hexdigest(), actual_bytes=size
                )
                if target.name.endswith(".fits"):
                    with fits.open(target, memmap=True) as hdul:
                        verify_expected_fits_rows(hdul, item.get("expected_fits_rows"))
                        result["fits_tables"] = [
                            {
                                "name": h.name,
                                "rows": h.header.get("NAXIS2"),
                                "columns": h.columns.names,
                                "units": {c.name: c.unit for c in h.columns if c.unit},
                            }
                            for h in hdul
                            if isinstance(h, fits.BinTableHDU)
                        ]
                        # Candidate discovery only: keep raw uncertainties/flags and original row.
                        for h in hdul:
                            if not isinstance(h, fits.BinTableHDU):
                                continue
                            columns = {c.lower(): c for c in h.columns.names}
                            metal = next(
                                (
                                    columns[k]
                                    for k in ["feh", "fe_h", "[fe/h]"]
                                    if k in columns
                                ),
                                None,
                            )
                            if metal is None:
                                continue
                            value = np.asarray(h.data[metal])
                            rows = np.flatnonzero(
                                np.isfinite(value) & (value < -2) & (value > -6)
                            )
                            rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
                            rng.shuffle(rows)
                            rows = rows[:50000]
                            rows.sort()
                            if len(rows):
                                candidate = target.with_name(
                                    target.stem + "-candidate-sample.fits"
                                )
                                fits.BinTableHDU(h.data[rows], name=h.name).writeto(
                                    candidate, overwrite=False
                                )
                                result["candidate_sample"] = {
                                    "path": str(candidate),
                                    "rows": len(rows),
                                    "original_row_indices_file": str(candidate)
                                    + ".rows.npy",
                                    "selection": "seed42 uniform among nominal raw metallicity<-2; uncorrected values, retain original uncertainties/flags; not independent XP truth",
                                }
                                np.save(str(candidate) + ".rows.npy", rows)
                            break
                raw_copy = published.with_suffix(published.suffix + ".copying")
                if raw_copy.exists():
                    raise FileExistsError(raw_copy)
                shutil.copyfile(target, raw_copy)
                raw_copy.replace(published)
                if result.get("candidate_sample"):
                    candidate = Path(result["candidate_sample"]["path"])
                    sample_output = args.output / candidate.name
                    shutil.copyfile(candidate, sample_output)
                    shutil.copyfile(
                        str(candidate) + ".rows.npy", str(sample_output) + ".rows.npy"
                    )
                    result["candidate_sample"].update(
                        path=str(sample_output),
                        original_row_indices_file=str(sample_output) + ".rows.npy",
                    )
            else:
                result["download_status"] = "metadata_only_or_exceeds_limit"
        except Exception as error:
            result["error"] = str(error)
        results.append(result)
        atomic_json(args.output / "collection.json", results)
    return {
        "sources": results,
        "scientific_ingestion_complete": False,
        "note": "Raw candidate samples require verified survey-specific ID joins, quality flags, uncertainties and correction application before scientific labels are eligible",
    }
